name: VinDr-Mammo: Full-Field Digital Mammography Dataset
description: VinDr-Mammo is a public benchmark dataset containing 20,000 full-field digital mammography (FFDM) examinations (5,000 four-view breast screening exams) collected from two major hospitals in Vietnam. Each examination was independently annotated by three experienced radiologists for breast density, BI-RADS assessment categories, and bounding boxes for suspicious breast lesions.
